metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of carbonate chemistry and shell properties of Magallana hongkongensis under varying CO₂ treatments
metadata.description: The dataset comprises 27 laboratory observations of the oyster Magallana hongkongensis collected at a single location (Zhanjiang) on 2016‑06‑01. Each row represents a distinct experimental treatment (Treat) and includes water‑chemistry variables (pH, temperature, salinity, total alkalinity, pCO₂, carbonate species, saturation states), shell porosity, and mechanical properties (stiffness, hardness, density, volumes) where available, together with metadata such as species taxonomy, event name, and geographic coordinates.
